entries.zh: 管礼拜者；偶像祭拜的庙祝、司仪
entries.en: sacristan of the idol; keeper and officiant of idol worship

entries.zh: 礼拜司事（首字字形存疑）；管偶像祭拜者
entries.en: officiant of idol worship (first Chinese character uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉栏首字[疑:音/暜]两读难定，职能据西栏 Sacristan del idolo 与后两字“礼拜”定释。

entries.en: temple incense-keeper; attendant in charge of the incense
to beat, thrash; to strike
entries.notes: 西栏“a costar”疑为 azotar（抽打）残读，M 栏例词串尾部[残]；主释义据汉栏“打”与 Sacudir。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 汉栏整条[残]，音写仅存两音难解，仅西栏残句 la cudir a costar 存留，无从定释。

entries.en: to knock, bump against

entries.zh: 轻拂弹点（如以羽毛或手指轻击）
entries.en: to tap or flick lightly, as with a quill or a finger
entries.notes: 汉栏作“献”疑为“撢（掸）”类形近字，轻击义据西栏 como la pluma o dedo 语境。

entries.en: to flap the wings rapidly
entries.notes: 汉栏[空]，据西栏 sacudir las alas apriesa（急速扑翼）定释。

entries.en: to dust or wipe the table with a cloth
to hit, strike; to make contact in beating
to beat without reason; to strike hard
to strike heavily; to deal a hard blow

entries.zh: 急促抖落；快速连打（汉栏首字残缺）
entries.en: to strike or shake rapidly
entries.notes: 汉栏首字[残]仅存“落”，急速义据西栏 apriesa 定释。

entries.zh: 急速连打（汉栏“落袂算得”句残，义未定）
entries.en: to strike in rapid succession (Chinese gloss damaged, not fully interpretable)
entries.notes: 汉栏首字[残]、尾句“落袂算得”难解，基础义据西栏 sacudir apriesa 定为急速连打。

entries.zh: 受嘱施打；被要求即下手打
entries.en: to beat as requested; deals the blows well when asked
entries.notes: 汉栏“断打”与西栏 si le piden le pega 对应依赖推断，疑指受命代行鞭打。

entries.zh: 打出去；耍无赖伎俩之类
entries.en: to beat out; used of roguish tricks and the like
entries.notes: 汉栏“处变”与西栏 bellaquerias（无赖行径、恶作剧）对应依赖推断。

entries.en: to beat cruelly; to flog mercilessly
entries.notes: 汉栏“着宴打”中字难辨，据西栏 crueldad 释义。

entries.zh: 献而却之、丢弃；抖却抛开
entries.en: to offer and then refuse and cast away; to shake off and discard
entries.notes: 西栏 desiamosjando 残乱无法复原，据汉栏“献却丢”直译。

entries.zh: 箭（西栏作 Salta 跳跃，对应存疑）
entries.en: arrow (Spanish headword reads Salta, 'to leap'; correspondence uncertain)
entries.notes: 汉栏“箭”与西栏 Salta（跳、窜）语义不合，疑西栏为 Saeta（箭）之误读或栏位错行。

entries.en: crossbow bolt; fire arrow
